notes.title: Turn Based Thursday Fest! - Up until June 9th
notes.content:
[h3]Ave, Legionnaires![/h3]
During this week our latest game, [b]King Arthur: Legion IX[/b] is on sale with a [b][u]70% discount[/u][/b]. This is a great standalone entry point into the King Arthur series, even if you haven't played the previous entry, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157390/King_Arthur_Knights_Tale/]King Arthur: Knight's Tale![/url] (If you did miss it, it IS technically still on a previous sale, ending on June 3rd - hurry and grab it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157390/King_Arthur_Knights_Tale/]here![/url])

King Arthur: Legion IX presents a dark fantasy version of the mythical [u]Avalon[/u]: in this turn-based tactical RPG you play as [u]Gaius Julius Mento[/u] who recently escaped Tartarus. As he arrives in Avalon, he sets out to establish a new empire for his undead legion: [u]Nova Roma[/u]. The path of the conquest is up to you: will you embrace your demonic side or find your humanity in this incredible journey?

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6y4Ny5yUCDw&t
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739830/King_Arthur_Legion_IX/

In addition to King Arthur: Legion IX, we have one of our older titles, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/310510/Deathtrap/][b]Deathtrap[/b][/url] on sale as well, with a [b]90% discount[/b]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/310510/Deathtrap/

Though you are fighting the hordes of the Ink in real time, this game still has tactical depth, and the progression is divided into "turns" of monster waves and tower defense preparation phases. Kind of fits, right?

The sale will last until [b]June 9th[/b], so grab any of these games - we hope you'll enjoy them!

notes.title: A Brief Summary of King Arthur: Legion IX
notes.content:
[h2]Ave![/h2]

On the [u]9th of May, 2024[u], King Arthur: Legion IX will be released on Steam, which means there are only two days left. Before that date, we would like to give you a quick summary of the game, with helpful links to the more detailed blog posts about various features.

King Arthur: Legion IX is a dark fantasy tactical role-playing game that takes place in the universe of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157390/King_Arthur_Knights_Tale/]King Arthur: Knight's Tale[/url]. It tells the story of an [b]undead Roman Legion[/b], whose members traverse the Underworlds of Tartarus and end up in a strange Avalon, twisted by the mad nightmares of Arthur. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DvRlHZv3Uw8]See our [b]latest trailer[/b][/url] to get a feel for the atmosphere!

[list]
[*] The protagonist of the game is [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2739830/announcements/detail/3977307906145135772?snr=2___]Gaius Julius Mento[/url], the tribune of the Ninth Legion, and he will be able to tackle various missions in a party of five combatants that could include the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2739830/announcements/detail/3966049540921865111?snr=2___]Flamen of Orcus[/url], the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2739830/announcements/detail/3950287576125445692?snr=2___]Flamina of Vesta[/url], the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2739830/announcements/detail/7792991106426831083?snr=2___]Praetorian[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2739830/announcements/detail/4134938965489708890?snr=2___]Sicarius[/url], and the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2739830/announcements/detail/4047116236904276193?snr=2___]Centurion[/url] - you will get to know them better through dialogue and exploration. 
[*] As he travels Avalon searching for the lost members of the Legion, Gaius makes various decisions that will push him towards a [b]morality[/b] stance. He could either embrace his demonic urges or he might regain his humanity. It's all up to you, the player, however! These decisions will drastically alter the narrative, including the endgame portion.
[*] There is also the matter of establishing a flourishing Roman colony on Avalon: you will [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2739830/announcements/detail/4112422231967796874?snr=2___]rebuild [b]Nova Roma[/b][/url] and set out to make it the centre of a potential [b]Eternal Rome[/b]. This city will serve as your headquarters, here you can build and upgrade various buildings (like the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2739830/announcements/detail/4134938965474873210?snr=2___][b]Lararium[/b][/url]) that will provide items, bonuses and titles for your characters. You should make preparations here between missions to ensure swift victory against all kinds of enemy types, for Avalon is full of dangerous mythical creatures and vicious opportunists. Not to mention, the Lord of Camelot is still around...
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38921839/a7a8ed918675e10673821d67fbc9158d3b6ec251.png[/img]

In essence, you will get a complete new story with a 30-hour campaign, a challenging endgame mode, multiple side events, arena fights, and the branching story also encourages players to go for an alternate playthrough. It is a standalone release at the starting price of $19.99, and while this game does not require owning and knowing King Arthur: Knight's Tale, returning players will certainly benefit from it (and can prepare for a little surprise at launch).

Eligible supporters of our original Kickstarter campaign will be receiving codes for Legion IX at release, make sure to check your e-mails! Also don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions.

And if you haven't done this yet, please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739830/King_Arthur_Legion_IX/]wishlist[/url] the game, and make sure to check back when the date arrives!

[h2]To Nova Roma![/h2]

notes.title: Meet the Romans! - Praetorius
notes.content:
[h2]Ave![/h2]

We have finally revealed the release date of our upcoming tactical RPG, King Arthur: Legion IX, but we haven't unveiled everything about the game yet. Today we will be looking at a character that we did not mention so far, probably because he wouldn't want the fame and glory anyway. All he wants to do is serve eternally!

As the tribune of the Ninth Legion, [b]Gaius Julius Mento[/b] is an important figure in the grand hierarchy of the soldiers under Emperor Sulla. While he is an excellent fighter, he was still given an unflinching bodyguard. This bodyguard is a loyal Roman soldier, [b][u]Octavius Remus[/u][/b].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38921839/e79e904e0d9be3202a53ce015efb916b1a378284.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] He is, in fact, a praetorian, an elite guard of military praetors. Despite his prowess, he won't try to steal the spotlight, that's just not in his character. In fact, he is a very enigmatic person, and undead legionary proudly bearing the weight of his role of a defender. He is loyal, as evidenced by the fact that he appears beside Gaius when he emerges from the Underworlds.
[*] He wields a massive shield and utilizes skills around the theme of defense, such as Wall of Blades and Bulwark, but he is a fairly good melee fighter as well, capable of using his shield as a weapon (Shield Bash). When things get tough in the magical land of Avalon, you might want to turn towards a more defensive tactical approach until the balance shifts - the praetorian will be very useful in these moments.
[/list]
It would mean a lot to us if you would put [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739830/King_Arthur_Legion_IX/][b]King Arthur: Legion IX[/b] on your wishlist[/url] before the release date (May 9th, 2024), and if you own King Arthur: Knight's Tale, be on the lookout for a little token of gratitude when this new game launches.

[h2]Onwards to Nova Roma![/h2]

notes.title: King Arthur: Legion IX - Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[h2]Ave![/h2]

We're happy to announce the release date of our upcoming tactical RPG, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739830/King_Arthur_Legion_IX/]King Arthur: Legion IX[/url][/b]: it will be available on Steam first in about a month, more precisely on [u][b]May 9, 2024[/b][/u]! The game is set on the very same Avalon you might know from King Arthur: Knight's Tale, but instead of Mordred, it follows [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1157390/announcements/detail/6002801934210694386]Gaius Julius Mento[/url], the tribune of the infamous [u]Legion IX[/u]. 

You can enjoy this game as a standalone experience, however, if you missed out on Knight's Tale, now is a great time to learn more about it as it's on sale ([u][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157390/King_Arthur_Knights_Tale/]60% off[/url][/b][/u]) on the Steam #[u]TurnBasedThursdayFest[/u].

So that you can really get into the mood properly, we have also prepared an announcement date trailer!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DvRlHZv3Uw8
[i]A new threat looms over Avalon as the long-lost, infamous Ninth Legion of Rome has set foot on the mythical island. Their commander, the fallen hero, Gaius Julius Mento was granted a demonic legion by their dead emperor, Septimus Sulla to find a way out of Tartarus. But when they accidentally arrive to the magical realm of the Lady of the Lake, Gaius Julius Mento decides to subjugate the island and establish Eternal Rome there. First, however, he must gather his lost legion…[/i]


[h2]Main Features:[/h2]

[u]A Role-playing Tactical Adventure[/u] 
[list]
[*] Experience a unique hybrid between turn-based tactical games and traditional, character-centric RPGs. Manage and control a party of 5-6 heroes to explore and conquer the land of Avalon. Engage in deep tactical combat, tough moral choices, hero management, and the rebuilding of Nova Roma.
[/list]
[u]Prove Your Worth as a Tactician[/u]
[list]
[*] Every little move and every decision matters. Use covers, traps, flanking and an in-depth overwatch and opportunity system and turn the entire battlefield to your advantage like a master tactician. Sometimes meticulous planning, sometimes charging simply to combat will be the key to victory. The only difference between a successful or a failed quest may depend on the composition of your party only!
[/list]
[u]Heroes Straight from the Abyss[/u]
[list]
[*] Legion IX introduces six unique heroes who have risen from the Abyss to conquer the mythical land of Avalon. Level up, gain skill points and unlock unique skill trees. Loot, equip and craft hundreds of artefacts and create the deadliest fighting force that has ever set foot on Avalon.
[/list]
[u]Wide Variety of Abilities[/u]
[list]
[*] Use unique skills, Ultimate Skills and World Abilities to overcome the toughest challenges during your quests in Avalon. Take risks and explore various tactical options as heroes don't face permanent death at the end of the missions. Test your skills in different difficulty modes, from laid-back storytelling to brutal, unforgiving battles.
[/list]
[u]Not Built in a Day[/u]
[list]
[*] Build up and expand the city of Nova Roma. Make sure that your stronghold has the right facilities for your heroes that prepare them for different quests. But beware! Resources are scarce and you have to manage Nova Roma thoughtfully to keep it afloat.
[/list]
[u]Regain Your Humanity[/u]
[list]
[*] Your decisions have far-reaching consequences, influencing both gameplay and narrative. Through your actions, Gaius will either restore his humanity, or forever be transformed into a demon.
[/list]

Make sure to put [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739830/King_Arthur_Legion_IX/]King Arthur: Legion IX[/url] on your wishlist before launch. As for the base game, Knight's Tale has recently received the 2.0 overhaul and numerous improvements, so make sure to check it out if you haven't. Thank you for your support!

[h3]Onwards to Nova Roma![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38921839/0c4532b48b08ba982b958ca5e3f955e468d5e1e1.png[/img]

notes.title: Rebuilding Nova Roma
notes.content:
As he emerges from the depths of Tartarus, [b]Gaius Julius Mento[/b] finds himself on [u]Avalon[/u]. He soon finds traces of other Romans, but the colony they have established is now in ruins. Still, Nova Roma is a promising starting place for conquerors.

In [b]King Arthur: Legion IX[/b], Nova Roma will be your base of operations. A place you can call home, but also a place where you can improve your soldiers and issue various decrees. Here you can also take a look at the new Morality Chart's various bonuses, which will also list your decisions that have affected the values.

Like Camelot in King Arthur: Knight's Tale, Nova Roma is represented as a 3D model with individual buildings, opening up separate panels as you select them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38921839/689214ce1f2873c490bb78eb5eda1a0b1a1cb9cb.png[/img]
These buildings have various functions, and you can assign your soldiers to some of them to gain bonuses. Here's a quick breakdown of the various facilities:

[list]
[*] [u][b]War Council[/b][/u]: Here you can assign a hero to gain title benefits, and issue one decree after each mission.
[*] [b][u]Enchanted Tower[/u][/b]: You can create new Relic items here using Relic dust.
[*] [u][b]Training Ground[/b][/u]: Here you can improve physical attributes of soldiers and appoint a Master of Arms.
[*] [b][u]Blacksmith[/u][/b]: Dismantle items and upgrade your favorite equipment pieces here.
[*] [u][b]Lararium[/b][/u]: You can place your collected Lares here, offering various bonuses. (Read more here.)
[*] [u][b]Merchant[/b][/u]: Here you can purchase various consumable items, trinkets, and runes for your equipment.
[/list]
By upgrading each building, you can open up new ways to use them, which gives you more fighting chance in this twisted island full of savages and sinister magical creatures.

You will soon be able to start your adventure and make plans for the grand dream of [b]Eternal Rome[/b], as the release is inching closer, with an exact date to be revealed soon.

[h2]Vae victis![/h2]

notes.title: Meet the Romans! - Sicarius
notes.content:
[h2]Ave, all![/h2]

Following in the footsteps of [u]King Arthur: Knight's Tale[/u], we have another dark fantasy game cooking in the proverbial oven, and that game is [b]King Arthur: Legion IX[/b], a Roman-themed tactical RPG set on the magical island of Avalon.

Today we are taking a look at a character who isn't exactly essential to the main story, but he will be a very interesting addition to the party - both because of his [u]personality[/u] and his [u]skills[/u].

This character introduces himself as [b]Sicarius[/b], the meaning of which is "dagger-wielder", or in a less literal sense, "assassin".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44806807/1b14341ab3b24a917515ecb0fb1b636dfc6aca0a.jpg[/img]
Our protagonist, [b]Gaius Julius Mento[/b] meets him in a less than ideal situation - Sicarius was supposed to ambush the tribunus with his insane companions, however, he remembers the way of the Legion. Instead of attacking, he gives a fair warning. He has no choice but to desert his former companions, and he will join Gaius to aid him in his quest to rebuild Nova Roma.

But who is he? Back then, he worked as a scout in the Legion, and he specializes in ranged attacks. As a child, he was a street urchin in the shadowy streets of Rome, so his senses are sharp, and he is never reckless. He is brave, charismatic, and rather jovial. No wonder Gaius decides to trust him.

It would help us tremendously if you would be kind enough to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739830/King_Arthur_Legion_IX/]wishlist King Arthur: Legion IX[/url], as the game's completion is slowly approaching... and the announcement of an exact release date isn't too far away either!

[h2]See you in Nova Roma![/h2]

notes.title: Lares and Lararium - A new building in Nova Roma
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739830/King_Arthur_Legion_IX/]King Arthur: Legion IX[/url] is our upcoming dark fantasy tactical RPG featuring Roman legionaries, trying to establish [b]Nova Roma[/b] on the land of [u]Avalon[/u]. As such, the game will make many references to the real historical and cultural treasury of the ancient Rome. A few of these, though, will be introduced as gameplay mechanic features as well.

One of these are [b]Lares[/b] (in the singular form: Lar). Such was the collective name of various minor guardian deities, depicted in the form of smaller statuettes and kept in the homes of Romans. This tradition was probably derived from even more ancient customs of the [u]Etruscan[/u] civilization, the word itself being derived from the Etruscan term for "[u]lord[/u]".

In the game, these little figurines can be found in various places on Avalon, wherever there is sign of Roman inhabitants. These appear in the game as collectibles, however, they do not appear in the inventories of the legionaries. Instead, you will need to build a new type of building in Nova Roma, called the [b]Lararium[/b] where these figurines will be displayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44806807/c85b601144c402e50e5ed42cac7502d308760071.png[/img]
Here you will have six slots for Lares you can own, and one to be selected as active (two if you upgrade the building). Once these Lares are active, they will provide passive bonuses for all legionaries, such as applying some kind of extra damage type or gaining back resources like Vitality and AP during combat encounters.

Be always on the lookout for these Lares during your travels to maximize your advantage against the forces that work against the interests of Nova Roma. Until then, please make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739830/King_Arthur_Legion_IX/]wishlist King Arthur: Legion IX.[/url]

notes.title: Meet the Romans! - Albina Virgilia
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739830/King_Arthur_Legion_IX/]King Arthur: Legion IX[/url] is an upcoming dark fantasy tactical RPG set in the world of our previous similar game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157390/King_Arthur_Knights_Tale/]King Arthur: Knight's Tale[/url]. 

Today we are introducing another companion: [b]Albina Virgilia, the Flamina[/b]. 

[list]
[*] She is a former Vestal Virgin who broke her oath and for her sin, she was buried alive somewhere in Rome. She is one of the recruitable companions who was not sent by Sulla, she came to Avalon and she was offered a chance to live as a priestess by the Lady of the Lake. She is still serving Vesta, bringing a piece of the Roman faith to the island, but she accepts other gods. She represents "Life".
[*] Before the Storm, Albina was responsible for stoking the Divine Fire that let other Roman souls find a home in Avalon, essentially establishing a prosperous Roman colony. But all of this was destroyed when Chaos erupted, and Albina had to hide herself with a spell. It will be up to the player to release her.
[*] In the game, she will take the role of a Flamina, a priestess, and she will be the opposite of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1157390/announcements/detail/3946909242518121154?snr=2___]Plutonius Nerva[/url]. Because of this, it will be obvious from the start that they will not share a common goal and will develop conflicts. Don't let Albina's polite and kind demeanor fool you, though! She too has a vision for the future of Legion IX, and will do everything in her power to work towards this goal.
[/list]

notes.title: Meet the main character!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739830/King_Arthur_Legion_IX/]King Arthur: Legion IX[/url] is our upcoming dark fantasy tactical RPG, a standalone story set in the world of our previous game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157390/King_Arthur_Knights_Tale/]King Arthur: Knight’s Tale.[/url]

Legion IX features a brand new point of view of an undead legion who come to Avalon to conquer the magical island. Their leader is the main protagonist, [b]Gaius Julius Mento[/b]. He is, above all, an undead Roman legionary who has just fought his way back from the Roman underworld, the Tartarus. He finds himself on the magical [b]island of Avalon[/b], otherworld of all Arthurian knights.

The Tribunus is a born commander, a highly intelligent and dutiful man, who doesn’t take everything too seriously, mostly as a partial consequence of him being dead and a prisoner of the underworld for a long time. He is not afraid of self-irony, which could be in stark contrast to his quite terrifying look as a creature of Tartarus.

In the game, he will present himself as a middle-aged, authoritative and commanding person, who's witty and knowledgeable at the same time. He should prove to be an interesting character to control in his quest to establish Nova Roma.

As he traverses the land of Avalon, he will meet new companions that can join his party. In these new conversations, you might learn more about his past, his future ambitions and his personality – however, the ultimate decision about his fate will be yours. Based on your choices, Gaius Julius Mento can either step on [u]the path to redemption[/u] or on the [u]path to embrace his demonic side[/u].

But why don't I let the man of the hour introduce himself in the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZVtaPzuT_zA]trailer for the game?[/url]

notes.title: King Arthur: Legion IX FAQ
notes.content:
[h1]Knights![/h1]

One more day until the end of the Steam Winter Sale - King Arthur: Knight's Tale is currently [b]50% off![/b] Our next game, [b]King Arthur: Legion IX[/b] also has a new store page, you can read a detailed description and wishlist the game there! And if you have already seen it, but you still have some questions, today is the day for answers!

[h3]What is [u]King Arthur: Legion IX[/u]?[/h3]
[list]
[*] King Arthur: Legion IX is a new game set in the world established in King Arthur: Knight’s Tale. This brand new campaign will detail how the Legion prepares for an invasion and uncover the remains of a Roman colony. You lead the skilled Roman tribune Gaius Julius Mento and his lost undead legion to conquer the nightmarish land of Avalon!
[/list]
[h3]Is this an expansion or a standalone game?[/h3]
[list]
[*] King Arthur: Legion IX expands the world of our previous game, King Arthur: Knight's Tale. However, we wanted to welcome more new players to the dark fantasy land of Avalon, so it will be released as a [u]standalone game[/u]. This new campaign is a completely separate experience and doesn't connect to the progression of Knight's Tale. It does build upon its location and style of gameplay, however. We hope to reach new players who are interested in the adventures of this unique undead Roman legion.
[/list]
[h3]Does Legion IX require a purchase of Knight’s Tale?[/h3]
[list]
[*] No. If you only prefer the company of demonic Roman undead legionnaires, you can just get this one safely!
[/list]
[h3]How much will it cost?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Legion IX will release at [u]$19.99[/u].
[/list]
[h3]Should I play Knight’s Tale before playing Legion IX?[/h3]
[list]
[*] You’re safe to play Legion IX without having played Knight’s Tale first. It is a completely standalone story with brand new characters. However, returning players will find the story and gameplay more rewarding with previous experience. It's up to you!
[/list]
[h3]Are the system requirements the same as for King Arthur: Knight’s Tale?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Yes.
[/list]
[h3]When will Legion IX release?[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Steam version of King Arthur: Legion IX will be released in the first quarter of 2024. A more precise date will be announced soon.
[/list]
[h3]What else do I need to know about the game?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Check the Steam description for more details. And please return to our threads on this forum in the following weeks, as we’re delving deep into the mechanics and lore of Legion IX! 
[/list]

[h2]Stay tuned![/h2]


Meanwhile, if you've been missing out on King Arthur: Knight's Tale, it has recently received a [url=https://neocoregames.com/en/community/hub/kakt-patch-20-and-rising-eclipse-out-now]hefty 2.0 patch and new seasonal content[/url], so this is the best time to play! You can also [url=https://neocoregames.com/en/games/king-arthur-knights-tale]sign up to our newsletter[/url] to receive an exclusive [b]Ivory Defender[/b] skin for Sir Mordred.

And that's it for today, just one more thing: it would mean a lot to us if you'd wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739830/King_Arthur_Legion_IX/]King Arthur: Legion IX![/url] If you have more questions, feel free to ask, and check back occasionally for more news and updates.
